exposure: Transvaginal repair of cesarean scar defects
Laparoscopic repair of cesarean scar defects
cohort: 67 symptomatic women with cesarean scar defects
finding: Transvaginal repair of cesarean scar defects was associated with reduced operative times and medical costs compared to laparoscopic repair.
mod_finding: This study compared transvaginal and laparoscopic repair of cesarean scar defects and found no significant differences in conception rates between the two groups.
